systems.system: ICT equipment for County Development Planning Units
systems.country_label: County Development Planning Units (Liberia Decentralization Support Programme)
systems.platform: Desktop computers, laptops, printers, air conditioners and UPS units
systems.owner: Ministry of Local Government, with UNDP under the Liberia Decentralization Support Programme, financed by Sweden
systems.tiers: County level: 5 counties equipped at the March 2026 handover (Grand Gedeh, River Gee, Maryland, Grand Kru, Sinoe), making 9 of 15; Bong, Nimba, Lofa, Grand Bassa, Bomi and Gbarpolu pending 'as resources become available'

note: Equipment handed to county planning units with no connection stated, so the class is equipment and no fact is taken; the deputy minister designate's count is 9 of 15 counties equipped as of 2026-03-27, donor-financed.
